description: Search NASA's Common Metadata Repository for Earth-science dataset collections by keyword, platform (satellite/mission), instrument, time range, or bounding box. ~10k collections covering MODIS, Landsat, Sentinel, VIIRS, GPM, and every NASA DAAC. Sorted by usage. Keyless.

keyword.description: Free-text keyword, e.g. "aerosol", "sea surface temperature", "land cover".

temporal_start.description: Start of temporal filter, YYYY-MM-DD. Collections overlapping the range match.

name: search_collections
